given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has reached their maximum workload capacity
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new delivery task to that partner
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the assignment and routes the task to another available agent within the same service zone

given_when_then.given: An agent has been assigned a delivery task within their service zone
given_when_then.when: The agent explicitly accepts the delivery assignment
given_when_then.then: The system confirms the slot as active

given_when_then.given: A delivery task has been assigned to an agent
given_when_then.when: The original agent rejects the task or exceeds capacity limits
given_when_then.then: The system permits dynamic reassignment of the delivery task

success_criteria: The system must prevent overloading by refusing to assign a delivery slot to an agent whose current workload exceeds the maximum capacity defined for their service zone.
The system must only confirm a delivery slot as active after the agent has explicitly accepted the assignment.
The system must allow dynamic reassignment of a delivery task if the original agent rejects the task or exceeds capacity limits.
